offers.title: Coffee Masterclass
offers.description: Trace a bean from grower to cup. Use synthetic receipts to test a partial redemption, duplicate scan, reversal and refund.
offers.needed: A consenting café, facilitator, accessible space and a reviewed lesson plan.

offers.title: The useful-things library
offers.description: A proposed borrow card pairs an object with a condition check, due date and useful service history.
offers.needed: An owner, safe-use instructions, eligibility, damage terms and a return route.

offers.title: First Harvest
offers.description: Imagine a nearby grower explaining what is in a box and when it can be picked up. Contents and quantities would be confirmed for each harvest.
offers.needed: A named grower, quantities, food-safety plan, pickup window, substitution consent and non-delivery terms.

offers.title: The neighborhood receipt
offers.description: A repair, a lesson or an afternoon of making gets a short story. Participants choose whether names, photos and details may be published.
offers.needed: Consent, a correction and deletion route, a delivery owner and privacy-safe records.

offers.title: The printers guild
offers.unit: One physical proof before a run
offers.description: Bring a collectible art master to a willing print studio. Check trim, bleed, stock, color and finish together before approving production.
offers.needed: A printer quote, process and stock choice, physical proof, permission, budget and pickup terms.

phases.title: Publish the idea
phases.work: City cards, campaign gallery, study PDFs, read-only JSON and a service blueprint. Original-art links retain authentic Nouns provenance.

phases.title: Rehearse one afternoon
phases.work: One consenting host, a small art table and synthetic service receipts. Agree who does what; observe confusion and revise the language.

phases.title: Build a moderated city desk
phases.work: Separate place, proposal and collection records. Consent, provenance checks, duplicate detection, review, withdrawal and accessible discovery come before public submissions.

phases.title: Evaluate a real service pilot
phases.work: Name the provider and exact delivery promise. Confirm capacity, customer terms, privacy, cancellation, refunds and applicable review before accepting an order or any money.
